system.description:
A turret costs 100Kcr and deals 1 damage.

Turrets are able to fire in a 180 degree area, with a gunner. Otherwise, with no gunner, they are considered fixed mounted.

Weapons require hardpoints in order to be installed. Each ship's hull comes with 1 hardpoint per 100T of hull. Additional hardpoints can be installed, up to x2 the hull’s original hardpoint, at 50,000cr each.

The book gives no range limit or tech level for starship weapons; range is set to long.

Weapon variant: A turret with two barrels is 400Kcr and deals 2 damage.

Costs 500kcr and inflicts D3 damage.

Weapons require hardpoints in order to be installed. Each ship's hull comes with 1 hardpoint per 100T of hull. Additional hardpoints can be installed, up to x2 the hull’s original hardpoint, at 50,000cr each.

The book gives no range limit or tech level for starship weapons; range is set to long.

Costs 1Mcr and deals 1 damage, but deals +1 for every additional round the beam maintains contact on the target ship. For example, if the beam maintains contact on the third round, it deals 3 damage that round.

Beams have a chance to overheat. Each round, roll 1D. A roll of 1 on the first round causes it to overheat, while on the second round of use, a 2 or less causes it to overheat, and so on. The Gunner Skill is added to this overheat roll to offset the chances. When a beam overheats, it requires a number of rounds of cooling equal to the number of rounds it was in use.

Weapons require hardpoints in order to be installed. Each ship's hull comes with 1 hardpoint per 100T of hull. Additional hardpoints can be installed, up to x2 the hull’s original hardpoint, at 50,000cr each.

The book gives no range limit or tech level for starship weapons; range is set to long.

The missile rack costs 750kcr and can hold up to 4 missiles. A missile rack can fire between 1-4 missiles in a single attack. Each missile deals 1 damage. Missiles impact a number of rounds later equal to the amount of range bands between attacker and defender.

Missiles: p.76 gives 1,000cr per missile; p.77 gives 5000Cr per missile (homing).

Each missile costs 1,000cr and deals 1 damage. Missiles impact a number of rounds later equal to the amount of range bands between attacker and defender.

Cargo (p.77): Individual missiles cost 5000Cr and are homing. The book gives two different prices; the cost field uses the p.76 price.

Weapon variant: This type of missile is used to temporarily disable the power system of a ship. Each missile puts the target’s power plant offline for 1D 10-minute rounds and costs 5,000cr.
